decisions.reason: Premium support is central to the agency-focused service promise, and its established investment gives management reason to persist rather than admit failure.
With a dedicated page and close fit to existing tools, this product carries visible sunk costs and high centrality, making withdrawal unlikely.
Although distant from core hosting, the own page and multiple models are a substantial public commitment, so the firm tends to keep justifying the investment.
As the flagship showcased on the home page and directly aligned with the announced direction, it has the strongest escalation pressure, so dropping is very unlikely.
